parsed.refutation_attempt: The reported OS Command Injection claim is unfounded because the sink function gcry_sexp_new does not execute shell commands; it merely parses the provided data into an S-expression. The untrusted source "filename" is only used in fopen (lines 9‑13) to open a file, and the file contents are read into memory and passed to gcry_sexp_new (line 35). No command string is constructed or passed to a shell, so there is no path from the filename to a command execution. Therefore the vulnerability is a false positive.
